text: NovaTech Solutions (NTS) was ranked #1 in the annual Forbes '100 Best Corporate Citizens' list, citing its strong performance in sustainability, community support, and employee relations.
LogiStream Inc. is partnering with 'AidFlow Global' to lend its advanced logistics platform, using AI to optimize supply chains for delivering medical supplies in disaster zones.
The FTC is investigating MedEquip Solutions (MEDI) for allegedly restricting 'right to repair', by making it impossible for hospitals to service their own devices, forcing them into costly contracts.
A coalition of 50 advertisers has paused spending with NewsCorp Global (MEDIA), demanding the company strengthen its policies against platforming 'demonstrably false' misinformation.
Foresta Timber (WOOD) has had its critical Forest Stewardship Council (FSC) certification revoked after an audit found 'systemic' violations, including logging in protected old-growth forests.
CyberSec Global (CYBR) beat Q3 EPS estimates, but its forward-looking 'billings' metric grew at only 10%, down from 30% last year, signaling a major slowdown in new sales.
Vertex Capital (FIN) has joined the Net-Zero Asset Managers initiative, committing to support the goal of net-zero emissions by 2050 and align its $500B AUM with this target.
NextGen Automotive reported a 15% beat on Q3 profit, but announced it would miss its full-year EV delivery target by 5% due to supply chain constraints.
NovaTech Solutions (NTS) announced a new target: all its hardware and software products will be 100% carbon-neutral in their manufacturing and operation by 2030.
DevCore Software's (DEV) stock is down 10% after a regulatory filing revealed the CEO has pledged a significant portion of his equity as collateral for a personal loan, raising governance concerns.
Innovate Dynamics posted a 20% rise in Q3 profit, beating expectations. The company also increased its R&D budget by 30%, focusing on next-gen products. No new ESG data was provided.
An investigative report alleges FastFashion Co. (FASH) is routinely destroying and burning millions of dollars of unsold stock, despite its public pledges on sustainability.
CloudSphere announced a new data center design that uses 100% recycled water for cooling, reducing its water consumption by 90% compared to traditional air-cooled centers.
A group of former employees is suing Digital Realms (GAME), alleging the company fostered a 'toxic crunch culture' that required 100-hour work weeks, in violation of labor laws.
InfraCore Build (INFT) has been awarded a $2 billion municipal contract to construct a new central transit hub, which is required to meet LEED Platinum and net-zero carbon standards.
Everest Reinsurance (RE) has sponsored a new $150M catastrophe bond, transferring North American hurricane risk to capital markets. A portion of proceeds will fund coastal resilience projects.
Environmental regulators have launched a probe into Alpha Semiconductors (SEMI) over 'excessive and unlicensed' water consumption at its main fabrication plant during a regional drought.
Atlas Airways (AIR) has admitted to a significant data breach, with hackers accessing the personal data, including passport numbers, of 500,000 customers. The breach occurred two months ago.
Quantum Chipsets (CHIP) confirmed a major data breach, exposing personal information of over 1 million customers. The company's data security practices are now under investigation.
The FTC is investigating NextDay Delivery (ECOM) over allegations it uses deceptive 'dark patterns' to lure customers into its 'Prime' subscription and makes it difficult to cancel.
K-12 Solutions (EDU), an ed-tech provider, admitted a data breach has exposed the personal records of 1.2 million students, including names, grades, and behavioral notes.
DataFlow (CLOUD) announced a new $300M data center that will be powered 100% by an adjacent geothermal power plant, ensuring 24/7 clean energy and high reliability.
RetailCo (RETC) has agreed to pay $18M to settle a class-action lawsuit over alleged wage theft. The company did not admit wrongdoing but will upgrade its timecard systems.
CopperGate Capital (FIN), an active asset manager, beat Q3 earnings estimates. However, the firm reported another $5B in net asset outflows as clients continue to move to passive funds.
CoreWeave AI (TECH) is partnering with the 'AI for Good' foundation, providing its processing power and algorithms to help analyze satellite imagery for real-time deforestation alerts.
A class-action lawsuit has been filed against LineHaul (RTR), alleging its truck lease-to-own program for independent drivers is 'predatory' and traps them in debt to the company.
EnviroCo (ENVO) announced a $50M investment in a new pilot project for direct air capture (DAC) technology, partnering with two national labs to test its viability.
Healthea Inc. is partnering with 'Cure.AI' to implement an artificial intelligence platform across its hospitals, aiming to reduce diagnostic errors and improve patient outcomes.
Curia Pharma (PHRM) received full FDA approval for its new oncology drug, 'OncoBloc', for treating a rare form of leukemia. Analysts project $500M in peak annual sales.
Zephyr Auto (AUTO) reported in-line Q3 earnings, but its crucial EV division margin was only 5%, far below the 15% expected, due to high battery costs.
Regulators have opened an investigation into DataVault's (DAT) automated hiring platform, following complaints that its AI algorithms are discriminatory and lack transparency.
SkyLink (TCOM) reported Q3 subscriber growth that beat estimates by 8%. The company noted that a recent price hike resulted in 'minimal' churn, showing strong pricing power.
